entities.summary: Joan Manel Balcells Fornaguera is a retired professional tennis player from Spain. He won one ATP Tour singles title in his career and reached the final in Scottsdale in 2002 and the semifinals in 2000 Heineken Open losing to Michael Chang. Joan Balcells was a athletes & competitors from Barcelona (b. 1975-06-20, Barcelona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
